start: Settings > Member app, no free days set; an enquiry in Enquiries that came through member Asha’s invite link

steps.action: In the card 'Bring a friend', type 7 in 'Free days for each friend who joins'
user_sees: Under the box: 'Type how many free days a member gets, with one tap from you, for each friend who joins through their invite link, or leave it empty to give none.'
Button 'Save free days' becomes usable
must_not: Days given to anyone just by saving this number

user_sees: Toast 'Saved. A member gets 7 free days for each friend who joins.'
must_not: A saved toast when the save failed

steps.action: In Enquiries, tap 'Add as member' on the friend, fill the form and sell a plan
user_sees: Sheet 'Thank Asha' with buttons 'Not now' and 'Give 7 free days'
must_not: The free days added before the owner taps
The sheet when Asha has no running plan

user_sees: Sheet 'Free days added'
'Asha got 7 free days. Their plan now ends on <old last day + 7>.'
Button 'Open <friend’s name>'
must_not: The days added twice
The words shown when no days were added
A receipt or GST made for the free days

user_sees: The new member’s page
must_not: Asha’s page instead

start: Today, card 'Joined online', a request from a person a member invited (other way in: Make member on Today)

steps.action: Tap 'Make member', finish the Add member form and the Sell membership sheet
user_sees: The same sheet 'Thank <member>' with 'Not now' and 'Give <n> free days'
must_not: The thank-you skipped because the friend joined from Today

user_sees: The new member’s page opens; nothing is added
must_not: The offer lost for good

steps.action: Later, open the joined friend’s row in Enquiries and give the days from there
user_sees: Sheet 'Thank <member>', then 'Free days added'
must_not: The row saying the days were given when they were not

start: Settings > Member app and Enquiries, the cases where days cannot be set or given

steps.action: Type 61, then 'abc', and tap 'Save free days'
user_sees: 'Type a whole number of days from 1 to 60, or leave it empty.'
must_not: A number over 60 saved
A greyed button with no reason

user_sees: Toast 'Saved. No free days for a friend who joins.'
must_not: The old number still used for the next friend

steps.action: Look at a joined friend whose inviter is not on the member list
user_sees: '<Member> is not on your member list, so the <n> free days cannot be added here.'
must_not: Days added to a different member with a like name

steps.action: Look at a joined friend whose inviter has no plan running
user_sees: '<Member> has no plan running, so there is nothing to add the <n> free days to. Add them by hand when <Member> renews.'
must_not: Days added to an ended or cancelled plan, or to a personal training pack

start: Enquiries, a friend whose thank-you was given

user_sees: '<Member> got 7 free days for this friend.'
No Give button
must_not: A second offer for the same friend

steps.action: Change the Settings number to 14 and come back
user_sees: The row still says 7 free days for this friend
must_not: The given reward restated as 14

steps.action: Give a thank-you where the first tap lost its answer, tap again
user_sees: The days are on the plan once; the row is marked given
must_not: The plan extended twice

steps.action: Give a thank-you for a second friend who has the very same name as an earlier friend of the same member
user_sees: 7 more days on the member’s plan, and the new last day in the words
must_not: 'Free days added' shown while the plan did not move (see finding FN-A5-panel-logic-2-3-01)

start: Enquiries as the owner, then as front desk staff

steps.action: As front desk staff, add a referred friend as a member
user_sees: The new member’s page; no thank-you sheet
must_not: The front desk able to give free days

steps.action: As the owner, give the days, then open the inviting member’s receipt
user_sees: A line like 'Extended free by 7 days (reward) to <day>'
must_not: The friend’s name printed on the other member’s receipt
The free days shown as paid for

steps.action: Look at what the member is told
user_sees: The member sees the new last day in their app
must_not: The friend’s phone number shown to the member who invited
